notes.title: The Commission 1920 Update (v.1.4.0) AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37901227/cf426d8552fdb0b206d1b3ec28260019b51117cd.png

Attention to all Dons! 

The new update to The Commission 1920 is now available for all players!

TLDR Update Notes
With this new update, you can now:

 Create all-new custom campaigns.
 Partake in the new reworked random events system
 See what areas were affected by any Soldato or Capo assassinations.
 See what areas become vacant resulting from any game assassinations.


Changelog

Additions

 A new system has been implemented to allow you to play as your own customized family set up to take on New Shore in their own original way
 You can customize the following in your family

 Emblem
 Color
 Portrait. Imported images have a maximum size of 512x512px.
 Name of the Family & Don
 Don's Initial Trait
 Family-specific Title


 Family data is saved alongside the campaign save data
 Random Events Rework
 Random events and scripted events now play out using the Report system and the radio ticker

 In the report panel, you can find currently ongoing events and interact with them as they come along. This means that the Report panel is now a one-stop shop for all the events taking place and interacting with them, along with checking what their status is.
 You can also click on event slots to participate in them. 
 Events now have a default response (ignoring, or abstaining), meaning that you have the option not to participate.
 Multiple events can occur and run concurrently without clashing with each other.

 This new system allows for the following:

 More long-term events
 Events tied to specific turn counts or years
 Improved randomization and less repetition of the same event multiple times in a row



Changes

 Additional random events: New random events have been added to the game:

 An event where any of the 4 politicians can be involved in a scandal.
 An event where a minor family requests a long-term loan.
 An event where disloyal enemy units will provide intel at a cost.

 Flavor Text has been added to enhance Conflicts and Assassination Events

 New variants of flavor text for Conflict results.
 You can see these in the report panel and radio panel

 Assassination context flavor can be found in:

 Any and all unit deaths/removals.
 Report entries that show if an assignment became vacant as a result of a unit being removed from the family.



Known Issues
Nothing major at this time

Join our Discord and follow us on Twitter and Instagram to hop on The Commission conversation!

notes.title: Commission 1920: New Update Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37901227/bf7b76e3a17ef2b15530127318f8a443957b5534.png

Hi everyone! We have an exciting update planned for the game, which includes a feature the community has wanted since the original game!! Let's get to it ːwinter2019cooldogː

The Future Update Will Include:

Random Events Rework


 We redesigned the way we handle random events from the ground up!
 Random events no longer popup at the start of the turn.
 Random events have a new section dedicated to them in the report panel. Mandatory events such as the Commission Vote will prevent you from moving onto the next turn until complete.
 Multiple events can happen simultaneously!
 Some new events have been added that make use of the above features!


Create Your Own Family


 You can now select "Custom Campaign" from the main menu to play as a custom family!
 You can customize your family name, as well as your don's name.
 You can select any of the game's existing traits for your don.
 You can select a portrait graphic for your don, as well as select an emblem and family color


Join our Discord or follow us on social media to check out updates!

notes.title: The Commission 1920 Update (v1.3.0) TUTORIAL!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37901227/036f1ae6fdef7c0b95776b4d3823f2b5a278e723.png

Hi everyone! We've made some major updates to the in-game tutorial. We took everyone's feedback and made it more in-depth check it out!

v1.3.0 Changelog


Additions
Tutorial Mode


 You can now enjoy a short and concise learning experience using the tutorial mode.

 New Tutorial button on the main menu.

 The report prompter is now presented as a helper prompt that guides the player through the tutorial and basic information about how to play the game.

 The Tutorial walks you through using a scripted sequence of events that limit the actions except for the next acceptable action. 


 The game will employ softlocks to keep players from progressing past the current stage, unless they fulfill requirements.
 Save states are used to set up specific scenarios for you to learn the game, acting as guard rails.

 Deliberate enabling/disabling of Next Turn to keep the player from progressing the game state in an unintentional way.


 The following sequences are shown:


 Basic Controls

  Map Navigation

  Checking out neighborhoods

  Assigning Units

 Investing in Rackets

  Conflicts and enemy families

 Checking the Commission Rankings



Known Issues
Nothing major at this time.

notes.title: March 25th Update (v1.2.0)
notes.notes:
New Features

Hotkeys have been implemented for the Overview Panel.
Hotkeys can be set from the Options menu.
Can now reset to default settings from the Options menu.
Load menu now shows additional information, such as date and difficulty, for each save file (some features may not retroactively apply to old files).
Can now delete save files from the Load menu.
Closing the panel for an individual racket now brings you back to the neighborhood that racket belongs to.


Bugfixes

Fixed a bug that caused a freeze while calculating conflicts, when a caporegime died on the same turn.
Implemented some backend changes to make debugging easier.

notes.title: February 28th Update (v1.1.0)
notes.notes:
New Features

 AI has been reworked!
 AI players now have an Animosity value for each opposing family. This value increases when targeted by aggressive actions. Higher animosity means you're more likely to be targeted by them in turn!
 You can now view Animosity towards your family from the Intel Panel.
 AI players are no longer biased against assigning units to occupied territory.
 AI players are more likely to start conflicts when another family has low Muscle presence in their territory.
 The campaign Pause Menu can now be opened with the Esc key.
 The Options Menu is now accessible from the campaign Pause Menu.
 Added a confirmation popup and SFX when selling racket investments.
 Added entries to the Report Panel for conflicts involving your family.


Bugfixes

 Fixed a bug that would cause the game to freeze when processing conflicts, if a family was already wiped out by a previous conflict.

notes.title: February 22nd Update (v1.0.5)
notes.notes:
Bugfixes

-Fixed a bug that caused the main menu to flicker upon starting the game.
-Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze during "Processing AI", if the AI assigned a soldato whose caporegime had died or been removed from the family on the same turn.

notes.title: The Commission 1920 Release Date: February 11th
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37901227/c3e7c32c606ecefe7f2096e6f42f74c6f683f8d3.png

302 Interactive is pleased to announce we will be releasing The Commission 1920 on February 11th on Steam next month. 

Some words from the team:

“Hi all, we are happy to say that The Commission 1920 is nearing completion! It’s been quite a journey, one that started with the release of the original game in 2018, and only made possible by your support. We are still hard at work making sure that The Commission 1920 is balanced and bug-free, and we hope you enjoy the finished product!” – Zachary, Lead Developer

The Commission 1920 is a complete reimagining of their original mafia game, The Commission: Organized Crime Grand Strategy. 

You’ll be able to choose one of five families, each with its own perks and characteristics, you’ll also have a wide variety of illegal rackets to invest in based on historical mafia activity in the Prohibition era. You can start several campaigns in your efforts to be the top boss in The Commission rankings.

Some notable highlights that will be new with the game such as but not limited to; gathering intel on opposing families which could lead to getting access to an opponent’s inner circle, assigning titles to your caporegimes, helping with their agendas, unlocking journal entries that contain hidden messages or the inside scoop of each families history and more!

The Commission 1920 will be available on steam for PC on February 11th. 

You can join the family on Discord, Twitter, Facebook, Reddit or Instagram.

Wishlist the game today to get notified on release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330960/The_Commission_1920_Organized_Crime_Grand_Strategy/

See you next time,

The 302 Interactive Team

notes.title: Community Update #7
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! The holidays are almost upon us, if you haven’t already you can help the 302 team by wishlisting The Commission 1920. Wishlists help indies like us tremendously and really makes a difference (especially with pleasing the steam algorithm Dons)!

We have some awesome news to share, we’ll be participating in the next Steam Festival! This means you’ll be able to check out a demo of the Commission 1920 shortly before its release. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37901227/d130bb203190ef8d7ec8060d58a117aaec0d7997.png

The Commission site also got a facelift, check out the site and let us know what you think! Moving forward we'll be sharing blogs talking about how tos, lore, and more!

DEMO DEETS
The demo consists of a small part of the game to give you a good idea of what the full game is like. You’ll play as the Calessi family vs the Bogiana family in a 1v1 campaign. The map consists of Dreyer Square borough and 8 neighborhoods. The campaign will last for 100 turns, after which, you will see if you achieved a higher Commission ranking than your opponent!

Something to keep in mind, you will not be able to save or load campaigns in the demo and won’t be able to unlock journal entries. But you will be able to do this in the full game :)

We hope everyone enjoys the game and would love to hear everyone's feedback. We’ll keep you posted on updates as they come in.

UPDATES
We recently ended our Open Alpha and got some amazing feedback from everyone. BIG thank you for everyone’s continued support. The team will be working on addressing the feedback, bugs and updates.

Speaking of updates...here’s what we’ve been up to since our last community update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37901227/a062a79915cc1bb5db595f5a8d373d0e3edd4e78.png

We’ve been working on a TON of quality of life, UI, and art updates. 

Here are a few:

 Portraits: Dons, Generic Units, Mayor, District Attorney, and more!
 Top Bar Rework: 

 Family Emblem, Turn Display, and Funds Display have had their placement adjusted.
 Collected Intel for all families is now conveyed on Top Bar.
 Overview Panel buttons are moved to the Top Bar.
 Family Tree button now shows number of units, associates, and whether any unit should promote additional subordinates.
 Assignment button now shows unassigned units.
 Rackets button now shows whether racket investments can be redeemed for a perk.

 Territory Panel: received a complete redesign that removes foldout groups in favor of showing all neighborhoods in button form.

 Assignment Conveyance on Map Icons: Map icons for neighborhoods and boroughs now display all assigned units. Additionally, animated arrows will indicate whether an allied unit is arriving at the assignment, or leaving to another assignment.

 And more!


Thanks for reading and as always feel free to connect with us on social media.

notes.title: Open Alpha Testing & Release Date Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We have been working hard on The Commission 1920 and are finally ready to share the game in alpha. We will be opening up an Alpha Playtest event starting July 24th!  With alpha testing, we want to make sure we have the time to get everyone’s feedback and get the appropriate time needed to update things. With the current state of the game there are no tutorial features, we highly recommend players who played the original commission or seasoned strategy players.

In other news, over this last month we’ve been getting some questions about the release time for The Commission 1920. We originally were planning for a late summer release but we realized that to deliver a game we are truly proud of we are going need more time.

We want to make it the best game it can be and to do that properly we’ve decided to extend the release date to the end of the year. 


We hope with this extra time we can make the Commission the best game it can be and work with the community to make that happen!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37901227/3f5846e76585cb6656091e9055eafb1cae64bf81.png

That being said…..we’re doing an Open Alpha Playtest starting July 24th! We’d like to open this up for everyone but please keep in mind that there will be no tutorial. We highly recommend players who played the original commission or seasoned strategy players.

Open Alpha Testing

The Open Alpha will start on July 24th, this means we’ll be giving a handful of players an early look at the game to get your feedback and thoughts so far! The event will span roughly two weeks ending on, August 9th.

In order to participate in the event please sign up here! Please keep in mind that there’s only a handful of slots so remember to sign up as soon as possible :)

We will be actively working and talking with the community throughout the event via our Discord. Join us there to chat with us!

By participating in the event you’ll also get a nifty Discord role in the server as well. 

We’re super excited to have everyone be able to check out the game and looking forward to hearing what you think! 

Content Creators
Are you a content creator and interested in featuring the game? Reach out to us directly at collaborate[at]302llc[dot]com or reach out to us on Discord :)! We’d love to work with you.

notes.title: Community Update v2.0.0ap2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37901227/2437db44026c8fced5968f17d9f1ccdf190b7a12.png

Hi everyone! Happy Monday! We hope everyone’s weekend was a blast! Today we wanted to share an update on some cool stuff we’ve been working on. This includes the introduction of new systems and quality of life updates.

Introduction of the Agenda System
Caporegimes will now occasionally show interest in certain actions, such as investing in a specific type of racket. Completing the agenda before time expires will increase the unit's loyalty and reputation. Missing consecutive agendas will cause loyalty to drop.

Rebalance of Capo Tax System
In the previous game, the game highly incentivized to overpay to increase loyalty. Now, overpaying is less effective, and the baseline expected tax increases based on XP and decreases based on loyalty. Rather than using tax to increase loyalty, it should feel like you can use loyalty to reduce the tax paid.
 
New racket icons
Previously, each racket used icons based on the archetype (Gambling, Smuggling, etc). Now, each individual racket type has an icon as well.
 
Introduction of the Radio Panel
This convenient panel automatically displays report entries at the start of each turn, without requiring you to open the Report Panel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37901227/733472639d14c61b7ff6806b42fc6e5b4ce29697.gif

Community Update & Pre-Alpha Footage First Look

Main Menu
We now have a simple main menu to start a new campaign from, select a family, and difficulty. 

Save File Functionality

The game can now create and load save files, complete with time stamps, family, and other information.

Pause Menu Implementation

You can now pause a game and leave it. 


Planned Updates
We plan on doing an implementation of the Agenda System. We are also actively working on some new art for the game.

Pre-Alpha First Look

Knee Pit Gaming this past week checked out the game so far and he did a first look overview. He also shared comparisons from the first game. Check it out!

notes.title: Community Update v2.0.0a6
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We hope everyone is staying healthy and well. We wanted to share an update with everyone on what we've been working on.

Map Conveyance System
This week we want to share some updates on what we did to the Commission 1920 map system so far. We’ve developed a new conveyance system that acts as an overlay to the map graphic.


So, What’s New?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37901227/f57c476526adc6ae6720e48fb200137ebb4c0891.jpg
This new update provides visual information based on whats going on in the city of New shore. 

The colors used in the overlay are as follows:

 Color used for Player: Color of the Player’s Family is shown when holding majority occupancy.
 Red: Enemy controlled territory.




Borough

At the moment we have Borough’s colored gray if no allied units are assigned. It’s colored based on your family and if at least one allied caporegime is assigned to the borough. It will also flash red if at least one allied soldato is assigned without a caporegime to collect yields.


Neighborhood

This is colored based on your mafia family (i.e. Green for Bogiana) if at least one allied soldato is assigned in that neighborhood. It’ll be gray if no allied units are assigned. If there’s both an allied and enemy soldato that’s assigned it’ll be striped. 

The overlay will flash and turn red if at least one allied soldato and a conflict is ongoing.


Rackets

The map updates Racket nodes based on invested rackets in the area. Racket Tooltips and icon graphics were added to help navigation.


Additional features

We added “Scroll to Selection” functionality. So now when selecting a territory it will make the map camera translate to that territory.

We’ve been working on some exciting stuff that we can’t wait to share for The Commission 1920 Title System. Be ready to give your associates titles they earn from doing what they do best with the new Title System.

Title System
We did a migration of the old title and trait systems and revamped them for The Commission 1920. We also added something new for Capos! The following titles are available for Capos now:

Note: Family-exclusive titles will not show up in the list for families that can never unlock them. Other titles will appear but will show the eligibility restriction.


 Commission Emissary (Calessi-exclusive)
 Family Bookkeeper (Bogiana-exclusive)
 Top Enforcer (Junio-exclusive)
 Head of Security (Donano-exclusive)
 Head of Hit Squad (Rocca-exclusive)
 Underboss (requires high XP)
 Consigliere (requires high loyalty)
 Inside Man (requires recruitment from opposing family)
 Political Greaser (requires subordinates in rich neighborhoods)


We also added some new UI to be able to give Titles, show their availability, and upon selection show off information about the title. Titles will now show up on the Capo Panel, in addition to Tooltips. New UI has been added for associated Racket Icons.

We hope you enjoyed hearing about what we've been up to! If you haven't already join our discord and our newsletter to get additional information on The Commission 1920.
